tournament.name: Destination Qualifier - Modern Monsters Geddon Edition - Dungeon Street

decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to quickly put powerful threats onto the battlefield while controlling the opponent's board with removal spells and disruption. By utilizing cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sowing Mycospawn, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and shut down their strategies with counters and removal. The deck also includes mana ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Creativity to accelerate into its big threats ahead of schedule. Ultimately, the deck seeks to dominate the game through its powerful creatures and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on disruption and control through a combination of counterspells, removal, hand disruption, and card advantage. By taking control of the game early on with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, and then maintaining control with counterspells and removal spells like Murktide Regent, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Cling to Dust and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage and maintain resourcefulness throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts efficiently to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It aims to play a large number of artifacts, including powerful cards like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, to enable powerful synergies and maximize the effectiveness of cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. With cards like Thought Monitor and Kappa Cannoneer, the deck can maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Pithing Needle and Shadowspear. The deck also utilizes lands like Urza's Saga to further enhance its artifact-centered strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponent's plays with a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and hand disruption. It aims to control the board with early removal and counters, while gradually setting up threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with Preordain and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to ensure consistency in finding answers. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game through disruption and efficient threats to overpower the opponent.

This deck aims to efficiently ramp up mana and cheat out powerful threats early on, utilizing Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to generate extra mana and take extra turns with Primeval Titan to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and bonuses from lands like Urza's Saga and Lotus Field. The deck uses a combination of land tutors, combo pieces like Malevolent Rumble and Scapeshift, and utility lands to create a flexible and powerful engine that can quickly assemble a winning board state.

The deck revolves around using Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating mana with cards like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga to combo off with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces while Malevolent Rumble and Grapeshot provide a win condition. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Swan Song and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's board state. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. By using cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Utopia Sprawl to accelerate mana production, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its high-cost creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption, while cards like Writhing Chrysalis offer flexibility in dealing with threats. The deck's goal is to establish dominance on the battlefield while controlling the opponent's options.

The main concept of this Aggro - Hollow One deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards such as Blazing Rootwalla, Detective's Phoenix, and Vengevine, in order to bring out powerful creatures like Hollow One and Ox of Agonas for cheap or free. The deck utilizes cards like Burning Inquiry, Faithless Looting, and Goblin Lore to cycle through the deck and enable explosive turns. By maintaining pressure on the opponent with early threats and a steady stream of creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This Modern deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing a mix of creatures with powerful abilities and burn spells to quickly take down opponents. It also heavily relies on mana fixing and synergy between different types of lands to ensure a consistent and effective game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creature presence and direct damage, while also maintaining control through counter spells and removal options. It showcases a well-rounded strategy that balances aggression with strategic decision-making to achieve victory.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful spells. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while using cards like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to maintain control of the battlefield. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines provides additional avenues to close out the game. With a mix of aggressive creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and secure victory through a combination of speed and power.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to create a deadly synergy. By utilizing creatures like Delighted Halfling and Walking Ballista alongside various support cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Agatha's Soul Cauldron, the deck can control the board and generate explosive turns. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command provides additional win conditions and disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its synergistic interactions.

The deck focuses on aggressively controlling the game using cards like Thoughtseize and Counterspell to disrupt the opponent's strategy while utilizing Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent as powerful threats. By combining efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember with strong card advantage engines such as Expressive Iteration and Psychic Frog, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Spell Snare helps protect its key threats and maintain tempo advantage, making it a formidable aggro-control deck in Modern.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and hand disruption, while also utilizing card advantage and powerful threats to secure victory. By denying the opponent resources and countering key spells, the deck aims to outvalue and out-tempo the opponent. The inclusion of powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares ensures that the deck can close out the game quickly once it gains control. The deck also includes a mix of efficient removal spells and card selection tools to maintain its control over the game.

This deck is focused on quickly overwhelming opponents with a swarm of aggressive Merfolk creatures. Using Lords to boost each other and disrupting opponents with bounce and counter spells, the deck aims to control the pace of the game while steadily building up a board presence. Aether Vial provides additional mana efficiency and allows for instant-speed creature deployment. With a mix of disruptive spells and powerful creature abilities, this Merfolk aggro deck aims to quickly close out games before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and flicker effects to continuously generate value and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk, along with cards like Solitude and Ephemerate, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent. With access to removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, as well as disruptive cards like Relic of Progenitus, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to the necessary resources.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It looks to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell and Solitude, while also generating value with cards like Snapcaster Mage and Tishana's Tidebinder. The deck aims to stabilize the board with board wipes like Wrath of the Skies and Supreme Verdict, while also generating card advantage with spells like Memory Deluge. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while also providing flexibility and consistency.
